kal0: Has the effect of exercise been proven?
kal1: In a 2024 meta-analysis of five studies, exercise improved daily function more than doing nothing or minimal care, in both the short and long term. Its effect on pain was no different from a steroid injection, but in one study treatment success was higher with exercise.
kal2: NHS Ayrshire and Arran, RefHelp. Lateral thigh pain/trochanteric bursitis (greater trochanter pain syndrome). Version 1.0.
